issue.title: Inline sync status UI
issue.body:
## Context

- Part of the mobile sync epic: #14
- Depends on: #17 

## Background
Show sync state inline on the home screen using values already stored
in MMKV. No new API calls or SQLite reads needed — purely UI.

## UI spec
A single row sits between the "fluent" header and the Projects button.
It shows the current sync state on the left and a ↻ tap target on the right.
The row changes appearance based on state — no separate components needed.

### States

**Normal**
- Background: default surface
- Left: "Last synced: X mins ago" in muted text
- Right: ↻ in muted text

**Syncing**
- Background: blue tint (`#e6f1fb`, border `#b5d4f4`)
- Left: "Syncing..." in blue
- Right: ⟳ in blue

**Never synced**
- Background: default surface
- Left: "Never synced" in muted text
- Right: ↻ in muted text

**Error**
- Background: red tint (`#fcebeb`, border `#f7c1c1`)
- Left: "Sync failed: <step name>" in red
- Right: ↻ in red

## Tasks
- [x] Add the sync row between the header and Projects button
- [x] Read `last_synced_at` from MMKV and compute relative time
      e.g. "5 mins ago", "2 hours ago"
- [x] Show "Never synced" if `last_synced_at` is not set
- [x] Show "Syncing..." while sync is in progress
- [x] Check `sync_error_<step>` keys in MMKV — if any exist,
      show the error state with the step name
- [x] Tapping ↻ triggers the sync sequence (delegates to #XX Sync trigger)

## Acceptance criteria
- [x] All 4 states render correctly
- [x] Row sits between header and Projects button
- [x] Tapping ↻ in any state triggers sync
- [x] Error state shows which step failed, not a generic message
- [x] No global error toast is shown anywhere

comments.body: This is not the accurate mockup , this is just to get the idea of how the sync button will be placed and how its different states will be .
@Joel-Joseph-George This looks good to me for now I would not spend too much time on it though. I don't think we are planning to show that detailed of sync information for the MVP.
Used op-sqlite kv storage in place of MMKV.
